query: Delete the Contract content type from the site. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-remove-content-type.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken REMOVE-SPO-CONTENT-TYPE to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: The Contract content type is still attached to two libraries.
expected_behavior: Warns that a content type in use cannot be safely removed and does not force it
Suggests detaching it from the lists first with the detach skill
Makes no deletion without -Execute and the token
